launcher.notes: Crash-card freshness gate (old crash logs never re-show), real close-after-launch, and a fully detached game process - closing or even Task-Manager-ending the launcher can no longer crash Minecraft. Bundles Client v3.0.0 (the KUI release).

notes: Client v3.3.4 Signal: Discord Rich Presence (new Discord RPC module - shows Kinetrix as your Discord activity with server/world/menu + elapsed time; paste your Discord Application ID into the auto-created kinetrix/discord.json, no restart needed). Multiplayer server selector: always-visible refresh button, two-row header, overflow-proof search field with clipped text and clean ellipsis, professional NAME/ADDRESS modal forms. Module toggle re-application at boot made idempotent.
